Services section: choose a versionServices

Six jobs, one house.

Choose a part of the house to see what we do there.

01

Roof replacement

Torn off to the deck, and the deck checked, before the new roof goes on. Owens Corning Platinum Preferred.

  1. Roof replacement. Torn off to the deck, and the deck checked, before the new roof goes on. Owens Corning Platinum Preferred.
  2. Roof repair. Our repair crew carries flashing, pipe boots and matching shingles, so most repairs finish in one visit.
  3. Storm and hail damage. We photograph the damage for your insurance adjuster.
  4. Insurance claims. A line-item scope for your claim, and we can meet your adjuster at the roof. Your insurer decides the claim.
  5. Siding. James Hardie and vinyl siding, with house wrap and flashed J-channel.
  6. Gutters. Seamless aluminum gutters, cut to length on site, and gutter guards.

How many squares is your roof?

Roofers measure in squares: one square is 100 square feet of roof. Set your house's footprint, drag the ridge to your roof's pitch, and watch the count change.

16.8 squares, roughly

A rough guide from geometry alone: real roofs add overhangs, dormers and waste, so the written estimate measures yours.

Drag the ridge up or down.

Also: commercial roofing, EPDM and TPO, roof coatings, gutter cleaning, blown-in insulation, brick veneer, skylights and loft ventilation.

Storm section: choose a versionStorm

Storm damage, and the insurance claim.

Bunk Walker built this firm restoring storm-damaged homes. Here is who does what.

What we do

  1. Inspect the roof and photograph the damage.
  2. Write the repair up as a line-item scope.
  3. Meet your adjuster at the roof, if you want us there.
  4. Start only the work you approve in writing.

What your insurance company decides

  • Whether the claim is approved.
  • What your policy pays.

We never promise how a claim will turn out. That decision is your insurer's.
